features.name: Tot Bwd Pkts
features.description: Total number of packets transmitted in the backward direction from destination to source.
features.implication: Near-zero backward packet count is consistent with unanswered DoS flooding traffic.

features.name: Tot Fwd Pkts
features.description: Total number of packets transmitted in the forward direction from source to destination.
features.implication: High forward packet counts with few backward packets are consistent with one-sided flooding.

features.name: Fwd Seg Size Min
features.description: Minimum forward segment size in bytes, reflecting smallest payload segment observed.
features.implication: Minimum forward segment size; interpret together with payload length and rate.

features.name: Fwd Pkt Len Max
features.description: Maximum size in bytes of a single packet observed in the forward direction.
features.implication: Near-zero maximum forward packet size is consistent with header-only flooding.

features.name: Init Fwd Win Byts
features.description: Initial TCP window bytes in forward direction; typically -1 when unrecorded.
features.implication: Anomalous or absent forward window values can flag scanning or attack tools.

features.name: ACK Flag Cnt
features.description: Total count of packets with the TCP ACK flag set in both directions.
features.implication: Elevated ACK count is consistent with established connections under high-rate interaction.

features.name: PSH Flag Cnt
features.description: Total count of packets with the TCP PSH flag set in both directions.
features.implication: Few PSH flags despite many packets can indicate payload-free flooding traffic.

features.name: Bwd Pkt Len Min
features.description: Minimum size in bytes of a single packet observed in the backward direction.
features.implication: Zero minimum backward length is consistent with flows lacking return traffic.

features.name: Flow Pkts/s
features.description: Total packets transferred in both directions divided by flow duration in seconds.
features.implication: Very high rates are consistent with packet flooding; very low rates with slow or stalled flows.

features.name: Flow IAT Mean
features.description: Mean inter-arrival time in microseconds between consecutive packets in both directions.
features.implication: Very low mean IAT is consistent with rapid injection; very high with slow-rate traffic.

features.name: Flow IAT Max

features.implication: Context dependent; read together with flow duration and mean IAT.
